fullExplanation.text: Understanding The Seven Sacraments as an Economy

To study The Seven Sacraments as an Economy, begin with the concrete claims made under Sacraments. Studies sacramentality, institution by Christ, sign and grace, validity, fruitfulness, character, minister, recipient, and the seven sacraments as an ordered whole. The task is neither a loose anthology of citations nor an appeal to authority without reasoning. It is an ordered account in which Scripture is interpreted, Magisterial teaching is classified, historical evidence is contextualised, and scholarship is used within its discipline.
Biblical and canonical frame

The Seven Sacraments as an Economy is anchored in John 6:22-71, Luke 22:14-20, 1 Corinthians 10:16-17; 11:23-29. No protected translation wording is reproduced. The learner should read what precedes and follows, identify genre and speaker, and compare the proposed use with the wider canon.
